originalPromptText:
Extract invoice details from the text below.
Return a valid JSON object containing:
- invoice_number (string)
- vendor_name (string)
- total_amount (numeric)
- due_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- line_items (list of objects with description and amount)

Do not include conversational preamble or markdown code fences.

Invoice text:
{{invoice_text}}

suitability.reason: The task is a structured data extraction with explicitly specified fields, formats, and output constraints, all of which can be verified programmatically against the source text.

rubric.taskDescription: Extract structured invoice fields (invoice number, vendor name, total amount, due date, and line items) from raw invoice text and return them as a bare, valid JSON object with no preamble or markdown fences.
rubric.expectedOutputShape: A single valid JSON object (no surrounding prose or code fences) with keys: invoice_number (string), vendor_name (string), total_amount (number), due_date (string in YYYY-MM-DD), line_items (array of objects each having description (string) and amount (number)).
rubric.expectedInputTypes: Plain-text invoice document passed via the {{invoice_text}} placeholder, containing unstructured or semi-structured billing information (headers, totals, dates, itemized charges).

criteria.description: The response body parses as valid JSON with a single top-level object.
The JSON object contains all five required keys: invoice_number, vendor_name, total_amount, due_date, line_items.
The output does not wrap the JSON in markdown code fences.
The output begins directly with the JSON object, with no conversational lead-in such as 'Here is' or 'Sure'.
total_amount is emitted as a JSON number (not a string, not containing currency symbols or thousands separators).
due_date is a string strictly formatted as YYYY-MM-DD and represents the due date stated or implied in the invoice text.
line_items is an array of objects, each containing exactly the description (string) and amount (numeric) fields, with all itemized charges from the source captured.

All extracted values (invoice number, vendor name, total amount, due date, line item descriptions and amounts) match the source invoice text without fabrication, hallucination, or omission of material values.
